verses.1: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?
verses.2: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.3: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.
verses.4: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.
verses.5: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:
verses.6: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.7: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.
verses.8: Ask of me, and I will give thee the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.9: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter ’s vessel.
verses.10: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.11: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.
verses.12: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.
